why_not_committed: Derived data, 13.0 MB, reproducible exactly from committed code plus the snapshot id below. Same convention as classified-manifest.json: kept out of git so the topology change stays readable, kept verifiable by the sha256 here.
prerequisites: an ingested national snapshot in PostGIS
note: The row count is CROSSING POINTS between SOURCE FEATURES, which is what topology.split_at_junctions classifies. It is not comparable to classified.jsonl's row count: that file counted crossing PAIRS of graph LINKS. See classification-summary-v2.json.
